Your waterways. Your current. Keep the water working for you.

🌊 Streams Reflowing compatibility

  • Updated compatibility to Streams Reflowing 2.17.1.
  • Kept directed currents and Stillwater Anchors working with the updated stream water.
  • Preserved existing controller settings, saved profiles and Calibrator items.

📦 More ways to control your waterways

  • Updated the supported NeoForge, Fabric and Forge builds.
  • Added Fabric support for Minecraft 26.3.
  • Maintained redstone automation, controller linking, vertical flow sensors and boat mooring behavior.
  • Retained optional Create-powered current generation on NeoForge 1.21.1 and Forge/Fabric 1.20.1.

Update both client and server to 1.0.0.

This release requires the matching Streams Reflowing 2.17.1 build. Fabric builds also require Fabric API. Create remains optional.
